section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 1. NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor™ & Hyperion Commercial Conversion
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Institutional investors are intensely focused on how quickly AEye's validation of Apollo™ on NVIDIA DRIVE Thor translates into binding Tier-1 automotive sensor design wins. With automotive OEMs selecting autonomous platforms for 2027–2028 model years, will CEO Matt Fisch announce production agreements on the call?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 2. Defense & Counter-UAS Vertical Acceleration vs Lidar Peers
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: Unlike automotive lidar deployments that face long 3-to-5 year lead times, defense and aerospace counter-drone applications are generating immediate repeat purchase orders. Analysts want to see what percentage of 2027 revenue is derisked by defense contracts compared to automotive ADAS.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: 3. Cash Burn Trajectory & Path to Gross Margin Inflection
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: AEye's enterprise value is currently -$25.75M, reflecting cash holdings that exceed total equity valuation. If management can demonstrate that quarterly burn stays under $7.0M while revenue scales past $1M/quarter, the stock could undergo rapid multiple expansion toward Street mean price targets ($4.75).
